name: Wyoming

flag.description: A blue field with a white inner border and a red outer border, filled by a large white bison with the state seal printed on its side.
flag.symbolism: The bison once roamed the state, and the seal on it is said to represent the custom of branding livestock; red is said to honour Native Americans and the pioneers, white purity and blue the sky and mountains.

hook: Wyoming is the bison flag: a big white buffalo branded with the state seal, inside red and white borders.
trivia: The flag was designed by Verna Keays in a 1916 competition held by the Daughters of the American Revolution.
Wyoming is the least populous US state.
